summary: Verified Expo mobile preview is NOT stuck on a loading/splash screen. Navigated to https://sertex-enterprise.expo.preview.emergentagent.com at mobile viewport (390x844); Metro bundled the web target successfully (Web Bundled 450ms), React root #root mounted with 1224 bytes of content, boilerplate placeholder image (assets/images/app-image.png) rendered fully (naturalWidth=336, naturalHeight=729, complete=true) on the dark #0c0c0c background, no loading text or spinner elements present, and no page errors thrown. Console shows expected 'Running application main' and the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL log from app/index.tsx, confirming JS bundle executed and React tree mounted. Supervisor 'mobile' service is RUNNING. The user-reported 'stuck on loading screen' issue is not reproducible — preview is healthy. Only observation: a benign React Native web warning 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' emitted by the boilerplate index.tsx.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — move resizeMode from StyleSheet to a prop on <Image>. Reference: /app/mobile/app/index.tsx:12 (style prop contains resizeMode: 'contain'). Non-blocking, boilerplate-only.

action_items: No action required to unblock the preview — it is loading correctly. When the mobile UI starts getting built, move resizeMode from StyleSheet to the <Image resizeMode='contain' /> prop in /app/mobile/app/index.tsx to silence the RN web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx returns null while icon fonts load — acceptable, but if useIconFonts ever hangs the app will render nothing. Add a timeout fallback once real screens are built.
app/index.tsx uses style.resizeMode which is deprecated on RN web; use the resizeMode prop.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile app is still Expo boilerplate — only a placeholder image on #0c0c0c. Expo preview URL https://sertex-enterprise.expo.preview.emergentagent.com is confirmed loading (React mounts, image renders, no stuck spinner). Supervisor 'mobile' is RUNNING on port 3001. EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL is preconfigured; tunnel mode is NOT used in this managed env. When real screens land, retest at 390x844 viewport and rely on testID selectors.
rca of the issue: User report: 'Expo preview stuck on loading screen — enable tunnel mode'. RCA: Not reproducible after 'sudo supervisorctl restart mobile'. Metro rebundled cleanly (Web Bundled 450ms), React root mounted with the boilerplate <Image> and the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL console log fired. Tunnel mode is not applicable in this Emergent-managed environment — the preview is served through the preconfigured EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL. Most likely original cause was a transient Metro bundling state before the supervisor restart. Mitigation already applied: restart of the 'mobile' supervisor service; preview now healthy.
